name: セキュリティ点検
tagline: A monthly nudge to audit your own account security, one service at a time.
description: Once a month it points you at one everyday service, bank, broker, inbox, and walks you through its security settings step by step. Each visit hands you a short checklist to work through. It never signs in anywhere and never asks for credentials, so every change stays in your hands.
author: sapjpx
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
